limitations: Live training advances during this finite audit; each file receipt and common-rank prefix defines the snapshot, not current GPU liveness.
Progress/checkpoint and owner heartbeat can lag journal updates. PAUSED may be cooperative continuation; no scientific failure inferred.
Only two behavior windows per route classify saturation/cost ties; no inference that these bounded candidate proportions represent all collections.
All ranks and inner updates repeat global quality counters: deduplicated once per collection. No partial NAV score, new scoring, bootstrap, model tensor or optimizer load.
AWFM/FPO rates or scalar loss units differ from PPO. Total gradient norms and scalar anchor loss do not measure per-component gradient dominance.

conclusions_zh: 五条已启动路线目前仍处于不足0.08epoch的warmup；S1救援尚未到0.5epoch启用点，不能把当前共同阶段当救援方法收益。
当前完整journal按collection去重统计G16成功支持、canonical全零及PG0；三者口径独立，候选池有严格高分不等于确定性B1部署提分。
S0/S1的同阶段全rank材料与标量一致性在单独对象给出；独立run身份不相同，未借用对方Adam或状态。
PPO每128scene约54秒优化；AWFM约54秒，FPO约60秒（不同host的观察值，非硬件因果对照）。PG0约3.3–3.9%，远高于canonical全零约0.05–0.07%；bounded窗口中多数PG0是成功EP饱和，不能全部称失败。
当前各已启动路线候选strict-high场景支持约90–91%，早/中/晚段未显示稳定上升；PG0在多数路线后段上升，但单遍不同scene分布与参数变化混合，不能因果解释为学习退化。
旧Safety完整12146场景×13点：121全观测持续zero、432间歇、257复发。训练支持、确定性部署失败和持续无解是不同命题。
